title: Senior Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform)
text:
Demo Co. Spruce is a scale-up building fitness apps. We are looking for a senior-level Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform) to join our mobile team. Work is on-site in our Eastmere office.

Our stack: kotlin. You will own the release process, review code with the team and ship features end to end.

A small, senior team. You will mentor less experienced colleagues.
